title: dipterocarpus condorensis subsp. penangianus
intro: Dipterocarpus condorensis subsp. penangianus, commonly known as the Penang dipterocarp, is a species of tree in the family Dipterocarpaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments. The health benefits of Dipterocarpus condorensis subsp. penangianus include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help to reduce fever and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit antioxidant and cytotoxic activities, and it contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
